Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a state sales and use tax exemption on labor and materials used to reconstruct or repair structures damaged by arson.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a state sales and use tax exemption onlabor and materials used to reconstruct or repair structures damaged byarson; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new sectionto chapter 82.12 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to materials and labor andservices used in reconstructing or repairing any residence or otherstructure damaged or destroyed by fire or an explosion related to thefire. The exemption provided in this section is in the form of aremittance and only applies to the state portion of the sales tax. (2) To qualify for the exemption under this section, the followingconditions must be met: (a) The property must be owned by a person: (i) Organized underchapter 24.03 RCW; or (ii) reporting a taxable amount of less than onemillion dollars in the calendar year prior to the year in which thestructure was damaged by fire. This subsection (2)(a) does not applyto property used as residential property; p. 1 HB 1750 (b) A fire investigator, as evidenced by a written report, musthave determined that a person knowingly caused the fire that damaged ordestroyed the residence or other structure; (c) The property owner or an employee of the property owner mustnot have been convicted of arson or reckless burning related to theresidence or other structure damaged or destroyed by fire; and (d) The sales or use tax is not covered under an insurance policyon the residence or other structure damaged or destroyed by fire. (3) A person seeking a remittance under this section must apply tothe department in a form and manner required by the department. (4) The definitions in this subsection apply to this section. (a) "Arson" and "reckless burning" have the meanings provided inchapter 9A.48 RCW. (b) "Residence" means a singlefamily dwelling unit regardless ofwhether the unit is separate or part of a multiunit dwelling.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to materialsto be used in the reconstruction or repair of any home or otherstructure damaged by arson. The exemption provided in this section isin the form of a remittance and only applies to the state portion ofthe use tax. The definitions and conditions in section 1 of this actapply to this section.
This act applies to labor and servicesperformed, and materials purchased, on or after August 1, 2011.
